Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother - Official Clip (2026) Giancarlo Esposito, Mahershala Ali
Check out the 'I Taught You Better Than This' Clip for Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, an upcoming drama action film starring Mahershala Ali, John Cho, Abubakr Ali, Laith Nakli, Tramell Tillman, Tiffany Boone, and Giancarlo Esposito. Take a look at a heated conversation from Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, in theaters now.

From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother is produced by Lucan Toh, p.g.a., Babak Anvari, and Bassam Tariq, p.g.a. It is executive produced by Brian O’Neill.

Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother is in theaters now.

Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown - Official Q Trials Overview Trailer
Get a deep dive into what to expect from the free Q Trials update for Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown in this latest trailer for the strategy game. The Q Trials is a new roguelite mode. Overseen by the omnipotent being Q, the Q Trials is built around freedom and replayability. The new mode challenges players to embark on a series of increasingly difficult runs through the Delta Quadrant, shaped by procedural events and random sector goals, creating a unique experience with every run. Extensive customization options allow players to experiment with crew assignments and unconventional strategies, including promoting Harry Kim to Captain.

Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown's free Q Trials update is out now, alongside the Equinox DLC, on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

GTA 6 Finally Gets a Rating from the ESRB - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
The Entertainment Software Ratings Board (or the ESRB to you laymen), has finally slapped the M for Mature rating on Grand Theft Auto 6. Based on that extended gameplay look on Netflix, GTA 6 will be hitting all the hallmarks of an M-rated game: violence, sexual content, alcohol use, etc. So something for everyone. In other news, 007 First Light's first DLC has dropped, and it's free for all. It adds a New Game Plus mode, photo mode, a new difficulty, and new missions in the TacSim mode. And speaking of DLC, Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown expansion has been delayed.

The Witcher 3 Remastered: How to Activate Alternate Outfits
Want to change the looks of Geralt’s companions and Nilfgaardian soldiers in The Witcher 3 Remastered? Here’s how to activate all of the game’s alternate outfits, including the Netflix-inspired designs for Yennefer, Triss, Ciri, Dandelion, and the Nilfgaardian soldiers.

These alternate looks are purely cosmetic, so they won’t provide any gameplay bonuses or stat changes. We’ll show you exactly where to find the setting and how to turn each outfit on or off from the main menu. We’ll also take a look at every available alternate outfit, including Ciri’s armored design, Yennefer’s stylish new look, Dandelion’s Netflix-inspired Jaskier outfit, Triss’s green-and-gold robe, and the Netflix-inspired Nilfgaardian armor.

The Witcher 3 Remastered is available now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Ghost of Yotei DLC Review – Echoes Of Sekigahara and Most Wanted
Ghost of Yotei's Echoes of Sekigahara and Most Wanted DLC, reviewed by Michael Higham on PlayStation 5.

"This wave of paid DLC for Ghost of Yotei is a great reminder of just how graceful and deadly its combat can be, especially with how it's further emphasized in the new run-based Most Wanted mode. I didn't expect to get the itch for another run each time I was struck down, but that speaks to Yotei’s satisfying swordplay and the way these remixed challenges pushed me to think harder about every tool available. Echoes of Sekigahara isn't groundbreaking as an extension of the existing story, but Atsu gets a brief moment to shine again and show a more vulnerable, intimate side alongside a charming foil from her past. The battles within are familiar and the views are still impressive, but this one-two punch is a reminder of how fundamentally great Sucker Punch's ronin fantasy has been, and a layup for anyone looking for an excuse to return to Ghost of Yotei."

Ghost of Yotei: Echoes of Sekigahara - Opening Mission Gameplay
Watch the first minutes of gameplay from Echoes of Sekigahara the new narrative expansion for Ghost of Yōtei. Split between the present day and flashbacks to Atsu’s time on the mainland, you’ll meet Nagato, a figure from Atsu’s past who has arrived in Ezo. In the present, you’ll explore a previously unseen valley once inhabited by The Snake and his gang of loyal followers, the Vipers. In the past, you’ll experience Atsu’s time in the Battle of Sekigahara and a key moment in her life before she returned home for her quest for vengeance. You’ll meet new enemies and find new heavy weapons, new armor sets, new dyes, and more.

text:
The Cat in the Hat - Official 'CATastrophe' Trailer (2026) Bill Hader, Xochitl Gomez, Matt Berry
Watch the new trailer for The Cat in the Hat, an upcoming animated movie starring Bill Hader, Matt Berry, Quinta Brunson, Xochitl Gomez, with Giancarlo Esposito, and America Ferrera, as well as Tituss Burgess, Bowen Yang, Paula Pell and Tiago Martinez. The new trailer features an original song, 'CATastrophe' by Hilary Duff. 

Meet the Cat in the Hat you don’t know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure with an edge, where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme. Doing what he does best, the Cat—voiced by Bill Hader—spreads joy to kids in his hilarious, signature and singularly irreverent way, transporting them and audiences on a fantastical journey through a world they’ve never seen before. 

In the film, the hero takes on his toughest assignment yet for the I.I.I.I. (Institute for the Institution of Imagination and Inspiration, LLC): to cheer Gabby and Sebastian, a pair of siblings struggling with their move to a new town. Known for taking things too far, this could be this agent of chaos’s last chance to prove himself...or lose his magical hat!

The Cat in the Hat is directed by Erica Rivinoja and Alessandro Carloni from their own screenplay, story by Caroline Williams, and produced by Daniela Mazzucato.

Warner Bros. Pictures Animation’s first full-length feature film, The Cat in the Hat, comes to theaters and IMAX across North America on November 6, 2026, and internationally beginning 4 November 2026. It will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures.
